limitations: Source declarations are not proof that a module is installed or that a View is effective.
Static XMLID references do not prove actor-specific runtime reachability.
Runtime model/action/menu totals come only from the hashed external evidence file.
Dynamic Python Action dictionaries have no stable XMLID and remain context actions.

claims: explicitly not effective inherited View merging
scope.python_loading: all non-tests Python files under each module
scope.xml_loading: manifest data and demo files only
